_comment: List every firmware build the flasher should offer. Drop the .bin files under firmware/<subfolder>/ and add an entry here. JSON has no // comments — use this _comment string for notes. 'chip' is checked against the connected board. Each entry lists its files with offsets: the three build files (bootloader 0x0, partition-table 0x8000, app 0x10000) OR a single MERGED image at 0x0 (idf.py merge-bin). Bump 'version' when you replace a .bin.
